notes:
Two regressions from v0.0.68's group-change fix, both found in the room within hours of shipping, both in the same function and both the same mistake.

ZONE ORDER. Zone cards in Zones, and the transfer and group pickers, stopped being alphabetical. `zones` has always been a display-ready sorted list, but that invariant lived as a `.sorted` REPEATED AT EACH ASSIGNMENT SITE plus a comment on the property. The new 15-second merge was a new assignment site and did not restate it; because that path replaces the list constantly, the ordering survived only until the first poll. Fixed by moving the sort INSIDE mergeTopology so both callers inherit it, rather than adding a third `.sorted` and leaving the trap for the next person.

GROUP MEMBER VOLUMES. With Master Bedroom and Master Bath grouped to Living Room, their volume sliders cycled between mute and their real level every few seconds while the speakers never changed — confirmed by polling the speakers, which reported a steady 14 and 18 throughout. TopologyParser builds members as SonosGroupMember(id:name:host:) with no volume, so they arrive at the struct default of 0, which the UI draws as muted. mergeTopology carried the ZONE's state forward but took fresh.groupMembers wholesale, so every merge silenced the members and the transport poll refilled them moments later. Harmless before this merge ran on a timer.

FOUND WHILE FIXING THE FIRST: fetchTopology carried its own INLINE COPY of the merge, and the weaker one — it dropped isHDMI (so a topology refresh silently cleared the TV flag) and capabilities, and used Dictionary(uniqueKeysWithValues:) which TRAPS on a duplicate zone id. Deleted; both callers now use mergeTopology. That duplication is why the sort invariant went missing in the first place: two copies of one rule, so a third site had nothing to inherit from.

FOUR TESTS ADDED, two mutation-validated — ordering including a deliberately reversed input, member volumes surviving a refresh, and a departed member NOT being resurrected by remembering how loud it was.

THE PATTERN, stated because it is now three for three: mergeTopology copies fields across by hand-written list, and anything not on the list silently gets whatever TopologyParser produced — a default. Volume 0 is not stale data, it is wrong data. GetZoneGroupState carries 29 attributes per member and the app uses four; everything else comes from separate RenderingControl and AVTransport calls on the faster poll. fZoneDiscoveryServiceDecomposition was rewritten around fixing this by construction rather than by memory.

DOCS: sonos-playback-contract.md 6a corrected. It claimed the HDMI input 'STICKS' when a TV is switched off — true over minutes, false over hours. The real sequence is three stages, ending with the input RELEASED: empty URI, PlayMedium NONE, and Actions collapsing to 'Set' alone so Play is not even offered. Both earlier readings caught stage two and generalised. The section now carries a standing rule: a claim about behaviour over time needs the whole sequence, or a note of how long it was watched.
